summary: Largo Inc. filed a Form 6-K on June 17, 2026, reporting voting results from its annual general and special meeting of shareholders held June 16, 2026. Shareholders representing 54,492,193 common shares (53.99% of outstanding) voted on five items: fixing the number of directors at five, electing Alberto Arias, David Brace, Alonso Checa, Daniel Tellechea, and Andrea Weinberg as directors, reappointing KPMG LLP as auditors, and approving the Amended and Restated Share Compensation Plan. All resolutions passed with majority support. This is a routine corporate governance filing of a foreign private issuer.
